hook_script:
## HOOK VARIATIONS

1. **[CURIOSITY]** "Everyone thinks Claude is the undisputed king of coding… until you see what GPT-6 Astra just did."
2. **[FEAR/LOSS AVERSION]** "If you’re still using Claude to refactor code, you’re burning 5x more tokens and cash than you should be."
3. **[ASPIRATION]** "How to build and debug entire full-stack codebases in half the time using GPT-6 Astra."

---

## FULL SCRIPT

**[0-3s] Hook**  
*(Fast cut to Garvit holding phone with split-screen terminal visuals showing red vs. green test runs)*  
**Garvit:** "Stop using Claude for coding until you see this new benchmark test."

**[3-10s] Problem/Setup**  
*(Overlay screenshot of trending HackerNews debate with glowing highlights)*  
**Garvit:** "Claude Sonnet has been the coding GOAT for months. But engineers just stress-tested the new GPT-6 Astra architecture, and the tables completely turned."

**[10-25s] Main Value**  
*(B-roll: Fast side-by-side terminal screen recording + animated token counter)*  
**Garvit:** "Here’s why Astra is winning:  
First—**token efficiency**. Claude burns massive context re-reading your entire repo. Astra uses targeted sub-agents, fixing multi-file bugs using **60% fewer tokens**.  
Second—**sandbox execution**. Astra autonomously spins up a virtual shell, tests its own code, and fixes errors *before* giving you the final output."

**[25-40s] Proof/Example**  
*(Screen recording showing Astra passing 14/14 automated tests instantly)*  
**Garvit:** "In a 1,000-line Next.js database migration, Claude choked on the auth middleware and hit rate limits. Astra resolved the database schema, updated the routes, and passed all tests on the **first prompt**."

**[38-45s] CTA**  
*(Garvit back on camera, point to bottom text overlay: "Comment ASTRA")*  
**Garvit:** "Want the exact comparison prompt and setup guide to try this yourself? Comment **ASTRA** below, and I’ll DM you the complete sheet right away!"

---

## CAPTION

Claude isn’t the undisputed coding king anymore. 🤯

We tested GPT-6 Astra against Claude across complex, multi-file repositories, and the HackerNews debates are real:

1️⃣ **60% Lower Token Usage:** Astra utilizes modular sub-agent routing instead of dumping the whole repo into context.
2️⃣ **Autonomous Sandboxing:** It executes and debugs its own code before delivering the solution.
3️⃣ **Fewer Hallucinations:** Zero broken dependencies on heavy migrations.

If you’re building micro-SaaS, automations, or full-stack web apps, switching your agent workflow will save you hours and cut your API bill in half.

Want my full benchmark breakdown and the exact system prompt I used for this test?

👇 Drop **ASTRA** in the comments and I’ll send the link directly to your DMs!
